events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 115 AM MST.

* At 1025 PM MST, The Flash Flood Warning for West Clear Creek has
been extended until 115 PM MST. Heavy rain in the upper West Clear
Creek drainage earlier Friday afternoon is likely still causing
high flows. Flash flooding is likely ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes, urban areas, highways, streets and
underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Verde Lakes, Hanging Garden, Indian Maiden Falls and West Clear
Creek Wilderness.

This includes State Route 260 near mile marker 225...and between mile
markers 227 and 229.

This includes the following recreation areas and campgrounds...
Clear Creek Group Campgrounds.

This includes the following swimming holes...
Bull Pen Day Use Area, West Clear Creek near the campground and
Indian Maiden Falls.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Verde River near the confluence of West Clear Creek and West Clear
Creek.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Coastal waters from Pt. St. George to Cape Mendocino CA out 10 nm
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, south winds 5 to 15 kt
with gusts up to 25 kt and seas 8 to 13 feet. For the
Hazardous Seas Watch, very steep and hazardous seas 15 to 20
feet possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Pt. St. George to Cape Mendocino
CA out 10 nm.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 4 AM PST Sunday.
For the Hazardous Seas Watch, from late Saturday night through
Sunday evening.

* IMPACTS...Very steep and hazardous seas could capsize or cause
damage to vessels.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Bar crossings are expected to be
particularly dangerous through these times, especially Sunday,
due to increased set behavior of the wave group.
